title: The 7 Best Hand Creams For Mature Skin To Restore Moisture And Relieve Tightness In Cold Weather - ELLE
text:
The 7 Best Hand Creams For Mature Skin To Restore Moisture And Relieve Tightness In Cold Weather While much of our skincare attention tends to focus on the face, hands often bear the brunt of daily life. From constant washing, to exposure to UV rays , and a naturally thinner skin barrier, it's a combination of these factors that can often leave them looking and feeling drier.

Add winter's colder drop in temperatures to the mix, and it's clear why a hardworking hand cream can become a non-negotiable in your skincare repertoire. 'In recent years, I've seen more and more patients wanting to treat their hands with the same importance as their face and neck, both in clinic and with a proper skincare routine,' says London-based aesthetics and NHS doctor, Dr. Alicia Gonzalez-Fernandez. 'We go from cold outside air to heated rooms inside over and over, this increases transepidermal water loss, which results in dry skin. Plus, our hands remain exposed to the sun all year round, all of which contributes to visible signs of ageing.'

With this in mind, protecting the skin barrier should be a priority, particularly during the colder months. Dr Gonzalez-Fernandez recommends looking for barrier-supportive ingredients such as glycerin, shea butter, and niacinamide.

Ahead, seven of the best hand creams that are guaranteed to nourish, soothe, and restore softness to even the driest of winter hands.

Ahead, seven of the best hand creams that are guaranteed to nourish, soothe, and restore softness to even the driest of winter hands. 1 Emma Lewisham Capsule Hand & Nail Crème 1 Emma Lewisham Capsule Hand & Nail Crème £28 at Cult Beauty Where some hand creams stop at the cuticle, Emma Lewisham's latest launch treats both skin and nails. With botanical actives that help protect that skin barrier from environmental stressors, and niacinamide that supports reduce the appearance of hyperpigmentation, it's a hardworking formula that takes a comprehensive approach to skincare. 2 DR SAM'S Flawless Hand Therapy 2 DR SAM'S Flawless Hand Therapy £16 at Space NK For those who want a velvety hand cream with a non-greasy consistency and a multi-tasking formula, Dr. Sam's Flawless Hand Therapy is a failsafe go-to. Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 3 Dior Le Baume 3 Dior Le Baume £55 at Dior A tried-and-true favourite of Dr. Gonzalez-Fernandez, this product has earned a permanent spot in her handbag. Praised for its multitasking properties, the formula combines centella asiatica, hyaluronic acid and shea butter to nourish skin, while also being suitable for use on the lips and body. 4 La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Hand Cream, Barrier Repairing Balm 4 La Roche-Posay Cicaplast Hand Cream, Barrier Repairing Balm £9 at LookFantastic Over time, mature skin often experiences a decrease in natural oil production, which can often lead to tight, dry hands. La Roche Posay's Cicaplast hand cream specifically targets these concerns with its high concentration of glycerin and niacinamide, creating a non-greasy protective glove that helps repair cracked, winter skin. Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 5 Clarins Super Restorative Hand Cream 5 Clarins Super Restorative Hand Cream £46 at LookFantastic For those who favour hand creams that help treat the appearance of dark spots, look no further than this targeted treatment from Clarins. Featuring Montpellier rock-rose extract, a hero ingredient known for its anti-inflammatory properties, it helps promote a more even-looking skin tone. 6 Caudalie Vinotherapist Hand and Nail Cream 6 Caudalie Vinotherapist Hand and Nail Cream Now 14% Off £12 at Space NK Grape seed oil is the star ingredient when it comes to Caudalie's cult-favourite formulas. Ideal for skin that is in desperate need of some firming and replenishment, it contains lifting and hydrating actives that target loss of firmness and dehydration. Advertisement - Continue Reading Below 7 Nécessaire The Hand Retinol Repair Serum 7 Nécessaire The Hand Retinol Repair Serum £38 at Sephora Retinol has long been a hailed as a hero ingredient for speeding cell turnover and supporting collagen production, so why not extend its benefits to your hands? Nécessaire's The Hand Retinol contains 0.25% pure retinol alongside AHA and glycerin to help prevent crepiness and aid skin renewal while keeping hands nourished and hydrated.
